policy.playerModel: Understat season shots/xG rates + ESPN recent SOT where exposed; expected-XI scoped
policy.cornerCardModel: causal recent team for/against rates; historical calibration is a separate promotion gate
policy.formation: actual ESPN formation when exposed; otherwise recency-weighted prior actual formations
policy.travel: club-base and previous-venue to fixture venue-city great-circle distance
policy.validatedEventModels: corners, yellow cards, team shots, team SOT use frozen HBT-1.3 event calibration; red cards remain research-only
policy.readiness: player props require >=6 matched expected-XI players per side; corners/cards require >=3 recent stat rows per side; no missing-as-zero
policy.eventRuntime: validated HBT-1.3 Football-Data causal replay over previous+current season; target date excluded; odds unused
policy.playerPropRuntime: HBT-1.3 frozen scale calibration; all six holdout families beat position baseline; actionable only on confirmed XI

travel.semantics: great-circle venue-city distance; not a flight-path estimate
